purpose: Pin the detached execution chain, the C compiler omitted from the base preregistration, and an exact referee build-identity conformance control before namespace 255 is admitted.

conformance_identity.stdout_framing: exactly one UTF-8 JSON line terminated by LF with no CR

additional_predicates.source_authentication: Every one of the 494 clean-clone files must reproduce its frozen Git blob before configuration.
additional_predicates.engine_stderr_policy: Both real-join stderr artifacts must exist and be zero bytes; missing artifacts fail closed and are never synthesized.
additional_predicates.product_admission: The clean product HEAD and tree recorded in the immutable start receipt must contain the base preregistration commit as an ancestor and remain unchanged through close.

controller_corrections_before_seal: Use the observed gcc.exe byte count and digest.
Parenthesize UTF-8 ls-tree text before line splitting.
Fail when a candidate stderr artifact is absent instead of creating an empty substitute.
Materialize all final Git status arrays before evaluating their counts.
stopping_rule: All base predicates remain mandatory. The additional predicates in this addendum may only reject the run; they do not weaken, replace or reinterpret any frozen expectation. Namespace 255 is single-use and must be preserved on pass or failure.
claim_boundary: A pass qualifies this exact referee build, its tests and one real candidate capability join as engineering evidence only. It is not timing, Elo, OpenBench or release evidence.
